Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent repeatedly failed to execute the specific instruction to open the direct URLs of the IMDb biography page and the Wikipedia page for Brij Sadanah to extract the death location data. Instead of navigating to `https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0109279/bio` and `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Brij_Sadanah` as instructed in multiple steps, the agent consistently performed new DuckDuckGo search queries (e.g., "Brij Sadanah IMDb bio...", "Brij Sadanah obituary..."). While the search snippets provided by DuckDuckGo correctly identified the death place as "Bombay, Maharashtra, India," the agent did not follow the procedural instruction to visit the primary source pages. This represents a failure in the "FileSurfer" (or in this context, the browsing/navigation) capability to access specific URLs, leading to a reliance on secondary search snippets rather than the requested primary sources, which could have introduced verification errors if the snippets had been inaccurate. The Planner's repeated instructions were ignored, and the agent never successfully "opened" the specific pages required to confirm the data as per the protocol.
